parts.t: Montecito. Amazing location on this 7,215 SQFT lot with over 3000 SQFT on 2 levels. 4 Bedrooms + Den & 3 Bathrooms. Room to add an extra bedroom upstairs or keep as a TV area. Double living room with two fireplaces. Upgraded interlock brick driveway, custom patio in the yard & built-in air conditioning. Steps to Camrose Park. Walking distance to Skytrain, buses, elementary schools, and Burnaby North Secondary School. A must-see! All measurements are approximate. Easy to show.
